name: Not Fitting In
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are intentionally set apart from the world, chosen by God and called to live according to His purpose rather than conforming to worldly patterns. Though this separation may lead to persecution and rejection, as Jesus warned that the world hates those who are not of it, Christians are assured that God works all things together for their good. The call to transformation through the renewing of the mind enables believers to discern and follow God's perfect will, even when they do not fit in with the surrounding culture.
